newsitem.title: USA: Ametek holders okay Culligan merger, spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Ametek holders okay Culligan merger, spinoff.

text.p: AMETEK Inc said that its shareholders on Wednesday voted overwhelming approval of a spinoff of its non-water filtration businesses and the merger of its water filtration business with Culligan Water Technologies Inc.
The spinoff is expected to be consummated on Thursday, to be followed immediately by the merger of AMETEK's water filtration business with Culligan, the company said.

The spinoff entity will be renamed AMETEK Inc and retain the AMETEK ticker symbol and listing on the New York and Pacific stock exchanges. Common shares of the entity spun off are expected to begin trading August 1 on a when-issued basis.
Ametek said its shareholders of record on July 31 will receive about 3.5 million Culligan common shares or about 0.11 Culligan share for each share of AMETEK held.
The transaction also includes Culligan assuming $25 million of AMETEK debt.

Walter E. Blankley, AMETEK chairman and chief executive officer, said that with the transaction, AMETEK shareholders will have the opportunity to participate in the rapidly growing water purification and treatment market through ownership of Culligan shares and synergies from merging the water filtration business into Culligan.

"This transaction moves AMETEK in a direction better suited to our core competencies and allows us to take full advantage of the emerging opportunities in our worldwide electric motor and electronic instruments markets."
He said AMETEK is refocusing its businesses by shifting from three to two operating groups comprising electromechanical and electronic instruments products.
